request.description: Order ID that does not exist. Expect 404.
Negative order ID. Returns 404 (not 400) because path variables are not validated with @Positive at controller boundary.
Cancel existing order. Note: If order is already CANCELLED, returns 405. If order is DELIVERED, may return 400. Expect 200 for cancellable status.

item.name: OrderOpsController - Restaurant/Delivery

request.description: Owner accessing restaurant orders. In local env: 503 UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE (mesh auth not configured). In properly configured env: 200 if owner matches, 403 if not.
Non-existent restaurant. Expect 404 (if mesh auth configured) or 503 (local env).
Customer trying owner endpoint. Expect 403 ACCESS_DENIED.
Owner assigns delivery agent. Local env: 503.
Agent's assigned deliveries. Expect 200 (may be empty if no assignments).
Agent picks up order not assigned to them. Expect 403 ACCESS_DENIED.
Agent delivers order not assigned to them. Expect 403 ACCESS_DENIED.
Customer trying agent endpoint. Expect 403 ACCESS_DENIED.
Owner trying agent endpoint. Expect 403 ACCESS_DENIED.

item.description: Owner/delivery-agent order-management surface. NOTE: In local environment, owner endpoints return 503 UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE because the order service cannot reach the restaurant service's internal ownership oracle (missing SERVICE_JWT_SECRET configuration). Customer/agent cross-role tests return 403 ACCESS_DENIED.
